mia (DevEx): quick note — I saw a customer hit a cascade of 429s when doing parallel streaming calls. SDK default retry seems to replay without jitter and no idempotency header, so they got duplicate downstream side-effects. anyone seen this?

sam (SDK): hmm, can you paste the logs? is this the hosted API or dedicated?

mia (DevEx): hosted. logs show bursts of 429 then our client retries immediately, multiple times. timeline: request->429->retry->429->retry. no random delay.

jordan (Eng-Platform): we saw similar from a PLG customer last month. Our rate limiter is returning 429 when global quota exceeded, but retries without jitter amplify the spike. metrics: 15% higher retry QPS in that window.

alex (Support): customer report: "We retried POSTs and ended up creating duplicate tasks" — they didn't set an idempotency key.

sam (SDK): ack. current SDK retry policy is too aggressive for non-idempotent methods. We need two changes: (1) implement full jitter exponential backoff (per AWS best practice) and (2) only auto-retry POST/PUT when an Idempotency-Key is present or the operation is known idempotent.

mia (DevEx): yes. + also make auth refresh behavior explicit: a 401 should trigger token refresh and a single retry, but not unlimited retries for non-idempotent calls.

jordan (Eng-Platform): suggested backoff snippet (from discussion):
```
base = 100ms
attempt = 1..n
wait = random(0, base * 2^attempt)  // full jitter
```

sam (SDK): good. also handling 429 for streaming: when we get 429 mid-stream we can't safely replay from the start unless the server supports resendable offsets. For streams, SDK should surface a retriable error to the app, not silently replay.

alex (Support): customers expect "at-most-once" semantics by default. we should document the safe pattern: always send `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` for operations that mutate state.

mia (DevEx): proposal for SDK defaults:
- GET/HEAD: auto-retry with full-jitter backoff (retryable status codes 429, 503, 504)
- POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE: don't auto-retry unless `Idempotency-Key` header present OR operation flagged idempotent in method-specific SDK helper
- Auth: on 401 refresh token once and retry once if safe
- Streams: do not auto-retry mid-stream; surface error and provide helper to resume if server supports it

sam (SDK): sounds good. parity note: we need the same behavior across js/py/go/rust SDKs. currently JS had a retry-by-default behavior that Python didn't.

jordan (Eng-Platform): also recommend server return `Retry-After` header when returning 429 so SDK can respect explicit delays. If present, use that + jitter.

mia (DevEx): tiny UX ask: expose the retry policy as a single config object so apps can opt into aggressive retries for internal jobs (with clear warnings). default remains conservative.

sam (SDK): I'll open a PR to: implement full-jitter backoff, require idempotency header for mutating auto-retries, and add `retryPolicy` config. will add tests and docs. ETA: EOW for JS + Python patches, then port.

alex (Support): thanks — can you add a migration note for existing customers who rely on automatic POST retries? also include a sample snippet for how to add `Idempotency-Key` in common languages.

sam (SDK): will do. sample:
```http
POST /v1/tasks
Idempotency-Key: 4f7b2d8e-...
Content-Type: application/json
```

retry-bot: New issue created: #1242 "SDK: full jitter backoff + idempotency guard for mutating retries" assigned to sam (SDK).

mia (DevEx): action items: sam implement PR, jordan add server-side Retry-After where applicable, alex draft support KB and customer outreach. I'll update the SDK changelog blurb. :thumbsup:

sam (SDK): thanks — will update thread with PR link.

mia (DevEx): resolving for now. feel free to re-open if we see regression after rollout.
